caption: The video showcases five transparent cubic prisms resting motionless on a dark, glossy tabletop against a near-black background. From left to right they glow blue, show a red-orange edge, a cyan-green base, blue-red bands, and a red flank, while beams and reflections streak across the surface. The cubes never translate, rotate, or deform, holding fixed positions relative to one another and to a thin seam behind them. What changes continuously is the illumination sweeping the scene. The blue reflection at the lower left is strong early and fades, while a red-orange reflection column emerges and intensifies beneath the left-center cube, becoming prominent in later frames. Internal refractions shift in tandem as the left-center cube gains a blue glow and the right cubes brighten, reading as a moving light source altering wavelengths across the static prisms.
relations: Five transparent cubes remain fixed on the glossy surface while an unseen light source sweeps across the scene.
The lower-left blue reflection fades as a red-orange column intensifies beneath the left-center cube.
Internal refractions shift with the moving illumination, causing the left-center cube to gain a blue glow.
The right cubes brighten as wavelengths alter across the static prisms, reflecting the changing light source.
